rationale: The plan matches the reference exactly: DESeq2 LRT of ~condition+time+condition:time against ~condition+time, with explicit reference levels, per-time-point interaction coefficients with apeglm shrinkage, and within-condition simple effects for interpretation. QC is design-specific (blind VST, PCA by condition and time, distances, library sizes) with a stated no-drop-by-default outlier policy, the filter is minimal and tied to the smallest cell size, normalization stays inside the model, and BH at alpha 0.05 is applied in the test rather than post hoc. Enrichment was not asked but is well specified (full ranked list, stated metric, MSigDB 2026.1 hallmark/GO BP, 15-500 after intersection, seed); the signed -log10(p) metric using the mean of three interaction LFCs is a debatable direction summary for an interaction, though the plan acknowledges this and adds a sensitivity ranking. The report step lists method, versions, formulas, thresholds, tested/significant counts, power caveats and a reproducibility record.
